zh: 塔羅斯监狱 · 玩家自制经营练习
刷宝游戏工具箱 · 免费体验
en: Loot-Farming Game Toolbox · Free to Play

zh: 玩家自制规则练习 · 非官方版本
本工具由玩家独立开发，用于规则练习与策略模拟，永久免费，请勿购买访问资格。
en: This fan-made tool was independently developed for rules practice and strategy simulation. It is free forever; do not pay for access.

zh: 工具中的规则、随机参数及原创挑战可能与实际游戏不同，不代表官方规则，也不承诺实际游戏收益。
en: The rules, random parameters, and original challenges in this tool may differ from the actual game. They do not represent official rules or guarantee in-game returns.

zh: 本项目非官方产品，与《火炬之光：无限》的开发及运营方无隶属关系，未经其授权或背书。
en: This is an unofficial project unaffiliated with, unauthorized by, and not endorsed by the developers or operators of Torchlight: Infinite.

zh: 如有权利相关问题或发现收费转卖，请通过下方作者联系方式反馈。
en: For rights-related concerns or reports of paid reselling, please contact the author using the details below.

zh: 爱玩游戏的吉吉罗的抖音头像
en: Douyin avatar of 爱玩游戏的吉吉罗

zh: 作者 · 爱玩游戏的吉吉罗
en: Author · 爱玩游戏的吉吉罗

zh: 扫码打开爱玩游戏的吉吉罗抖音主页
en: Scan to open the Douyin profile of 爱玩游戏的吉吉罗
Scan to view the author's profile

zh: 扫码打开二零后游戏荒B站主页
en: Scan to open the Bilibili profile of 二零后游戏荒

zh: 无需购买、充值或激活，确认声明后即可免费游玩。
en: No purchase, top-up, or activation is required. Accept the notice to play for free.

zh: 按钮无响应？重新加载 · 保留本机存档
en: Button not responding? Reload · Local save preserved

zh: <small>当前浏览器未启用脚本，请启用后重新加载。</small>
en: <small>Scripts are disabled in this browser. Enable them, then reload.</small>

zh: SS14 · 玩家自制经营练习
从第一扇牢门开始，练习同阶吞噬、养成标记和奖励搭配。培养至臻选择刑具，培养绮彩选择珍藏；经营结束整理囚犯交接名单。
en: Begin at the first cell door and practice same-tier Consumes, development marks, and reward combinations. Reach Ultimate to choose a Torture Instrument, and Chromatic to choose a Warden's Treasure. At the end, prepare the Inmate handover list.

zh: 永久免费 · 请勿付费购买
新手推荐 · 经营规则演习
第 1 日，16 间牢房全部未开启。确认巡监后，迎来第一名囚犯。随机权重与耗天采用明确标注的练习参数。
en: Day 1 begins with all 16 cells unopened. Confirm the patrol to receive the first Inmate. Random weights and day costs use clearly labeled practice parameters.

zh: 开局配给 6 或 3 名囚犯与刑具。公开合约随种子变化；交付成功后选择刑具，留券侦察或刷新。完成至少两单且包含重囚。
en: Begin with 6 or 3 Inmates and Torture Instruments. Public contracts vary by seed. After a successful delivery, choose an Instrument, or save tickets for scouting and rerolls. Complete at least two contracts, including a heavy contract.

zh: 明确开始后才创建新局。新局可选经营规则演习或原创挑战；专项场面与未核实边界采用本地练习参数。已有存档可继续，旧版存档保留原规则。声音在首次点击或按键后播放。
en: A new run is created only after you explicitly start it. Choose Management Practice or the original Escort Challenge; focused scenarios and unverified edge cases use local practice parameters. Existing saves can continue, and legacy saves retain their original rules. Sound begins after the first click or key press.

zh: 正在准备经营入口，请稍候…
浏览器未启用 JavaScript，无法开始经营。请在浏览器设置中启用后重新加载。
en: JavaScript is disabled, so management cannot begin. Enable JavaScript in your browser settings, then reload.

zh: 作者声明 · 免费体验
查看目标说明与达成路径
en: View Objective Details and Completion Paths

zh: 公开资料支持的经营规则 · 未核实边界使用练习参数
en: Management rules supported by public sources · Unverified edge cases use practice parameters

zh: 开启辅助，查看当前场面的养成建议。
en: Enable the assistant to see development suggestions for the current scenario.

zh: 每次经营操作后，建议会重新计算。
en: Suggestions are recalculated after every management action.

zh: 当前场面 · 可执行选择
依据可见场面计算；未开启牢房和随机结果仍未知，不能保证最高货币收益。
en: Calculated from visible information. Unopened cells and random outcomes remain unknown, so the highest currency return cannot be guaranteed.

zh: 塔羅斯监狱 v0.6.14 · 玩家自制经营练习
en: Tartarus Prison v0.6.14 · Fan-made Management Practice

zh: 巡监、吞噬关系与养成条件
en: Patrols, Consume Matchups, and Development Conditions
Rules Explicitly Stated in Public Sources

zh: 本章列出公开测试预览中的文字规则；部分术语没有独立赛季标注，不能直接视作最终 SS14 规则。四兽、六条克制、同阶升一阶与随机变号，原实现已相符；本版主要新增四类标记与探查，并校正经营目标和收益表述。正式上线后的变化仍以游戏内说明为准。
en: This chapter lists rules stated in public test previews. Some terms were not labeled for a specific season and should not be treated as final SS14 rules. The four beasts, six counter matchups, one-tier gain from equal-tier Consumes, and random Code changes already matched the earlier implementation. This version primarily adds four mark types and Reveal, while correcting management objectives and reward wording. After launch, the in-game descriptions remain authoritative.
Can Consume Berserk Lion and Alpha Wolf
Can Consume Alpha Wolf and Colossal Rat

zh: 巨象不能吃硕鼠。基础关系不包含同代号互吃；持有鼠头串时，硕鼠可额外吃同阶硕鼠。
en: Mammoth cannot Consume Colossal Rat. The basic matchups do not allow matching Codes to Consume one another; with a Rat Head Necklace, a Colossal Rat may also Consume an equal-tier Colossal Rat.

zh: 双方稀有度必须相同。吞噬基础提升 1 阶，随后随机调整代号；下一次配对要重新检查。
en: Both Inmates must have the same rarity. A Consume grants 1 Rarity Tier, then randomly changes the Code; check the matchup again before the next Consume.

zh: 普通 → 魔法 → 稀有 → 传奇 → 至臻 → 绮彩
en: Normal → Magic → Rare → Legendary → Ultimate → Chromatic

zh: 绮彩囚犯离开牢房，单独收容。经营交接名单同时保留场上囚犯与已收容囚犯。
en: Chromatic Inmates leave their cells for separate containment. The final handover list includes both Inmates on the board and those in containment.

zh: 选择目的地，再确认开门。探查只显示稀有度，不会打开牢房，也不会显示代号。
en: Choose a destination, then confirm that you want to open the door. Reveal shows only the rarity; it does not open the cell or reveal the Code.

zh: 选择囚犯，查看同阶可吃目标与标记。吃与换的结果写入经营记录，可在本局管理中复核。
en: Select an Inmate to see equal-tier Consume targets and marks. Consume and Replace outcomes are recorded in the management log and can be reviewed under Manage Current Run.

zh: 至少一名囚犯达到至臻，选择一件刑具，在本局持续生效。绮彩囚犯单独收容后，选择一项典狱长的珍藏，立即生效。多份奖励依次选择，不额外耗日。
en: Once at least one Inmate reaches Ultimate, choose a Torture Instrument that remains active for the rest of the run. After a Chromatic Inmate enters separate containment, choose a Warden's Treasure for an immediate effect. Multiple rewards are chosen in sequence and cost no additional days.

zh: 按稀有度整理沙盘与单独收容的囚犯名单；本界面不模拟后续刷怪与真实掉落。
en: Organize the board and separately contained Inmates by rarity. This interface does not simulate the later monster encounters or actual drops.

zh: 专项练习提供固定场面，方便单独检查效果。标记的生成来源、出现概率和部分判定边界尚未核实；以下边界处理均在练习假设中明示。
en: Focused practice uses fixed scenarios so effects can be checked in isolation. The sources, appearance rates, and some judgment boundaries for marks remain unverified; the handling below is disclosed as practice assumptions.

zh: 更换带象牙标记的囚犯后，随机 4 名囚犯各提升 1 阶。
en: After replacing an Inmate with the Tusk mark, 4 random Inmates each gain 1 Rarity Tier.

zh: 未核实：不足 4 人时的处理、候选范围，以及换后囚犯是否参与。
en: Unverified: what happens with fewer than 4 Inmates, the candidate pool, and whether the replacement Inmate is eligible.

zh: 狂狮与其标记猎物在接下来的 3 回合各提升 1 阶。
en: The Berserk Lion and its marked Prey each gain 1 Rarity Tier over the next 3 rounds.

zh: 未核实：回合与经营日的对应、变号后的维持、离场后的剩余效果。
en: Unverified: how rounds correspond to management days, whether the effect persists after a Code change, and any remaining effect after an Inmate leaves.

zh: 划痕房间显示囚犯稀有度。头狼可吞噬其中的同阶囚犯，并额外提升 2 阶。
en: A room with Scratch Marks displays the Inmate rarity. An Alpha Wolf can Consume an equal-tier Inmate there and gains 2 additional Rarity Tiers.

zh: 未核实：额外 2 阶与基础升阶的叠加口径、划痕的完整生成条件。
en: Unverified: whether the additional 2 tiers stack with the base tier gain, and the full conditions that create Scratch Marks.

zh: 鼠巢等待 2 回合后打开，生成稀有硕鼠。提前开门会清除当前练习的鼠巢。
en: A Rat Nest opens after 2 rounds and spawns a Rare Colossal Rat. Opening the door early clears the Rat Nest in this practice mode.

zh: 练习按两次日切换计时；提前开门与其他效果的完整交互仍待核实。
en: Practice timing counts two day transitions. The full interaction between opening the door early and other effects remains unverified.

zh: 完整刑具池、随机权重、耗天规则与标记生成方式仍未明确。固定场面、默认 20 日和操作限制都是本地演习参数，不能用于推算正式难度或收益。
en: The complete Torture Instrument pool, random weights, day costs, and mark generation remain unclear. Fixed scenarios, the default 20-day limit, and action limits are local practice parameters and cannot be used to estimate official difficulty or returns.

zh: 囚犯代号和稀有度使用练习权重；巡监开启本日经营，吞噬不额外耗日，换默认每天 1 次，结束推进 1 日。探查默认每日 1 次。正式成本尚待核实。
en: Inmate Codes and rarities use practice weights. A patrol begins the current management day; Consumes cost no additional days, Replace defaults to once per day, and End advances 1 day. Reveal defaults to once per day. Official costs remain unverified.

zh: 象牙只从已开启牢房取候选，不足 4 人全部选取；是否包含换后囚犯由参数决定。猎物按日切换计回合，一方离场或变号后清除。划痕是否叠加基础 1 阶由参数决定。
en: Tusk candidates come only from opened cells; all are selected if fewer than 4 exist. A parameter controls whether the replacement Inmate is eligible. Prey counts rounds by day transitions and is cleared when either Inmate leaves or changes Code. A parameter controls whether Scratch Marks stack with the base 1-tier gain.

zh: 公开说明涉及囚犯之间的欺压。触发条件、数值公式和完整时点仍未核实，本演习不计算欺压数值，也不据此判断升阶或战斗强度。
en: Public descriptions mention bullying between Inmates. Its trigger conditions, formula, and full timing remain unverified. This practice does not calculate bullying values or use them to determine rarity gains or combat power.

zh: 新局接入已展示的8件刑具与4种珍藏。首次达成至臻目标，刑具候选三选一，获得后在本局持续生效；绮彩收容后，珍藏四选一且立即生效。候选完整性、刑具均匀抽样、逐只绮彩领奖、同次奖励先刑具后珍藏，以及额外升阶和触发顺序均采用练习口径。此前的经营存档保持原规则，新建一局可体验奖励选择。
en: New runs include the 8 displayed Torture Instruments and 4 Treasures. The first time the Ultimate objective is met, choose 1 of 3 Instrument candidates; the chosen Instrument remains active for the run. After Chromatic containment, choose 1 of 4 Treasures for an immediate effect. Candidate completeness, uniform Instrument sampling, separate rewards for each Chromatic Inmate, Instrument-before-Treasure ordering when both trigger together, additional tier gains, and trigger order all use practice assumptions. Earlier saves retain their original rules; start a new run to try reward selection.

zh: 本局参数不会被中途自动替换。旧版存档和原创挑战保留各自规则；存档继续按原模式读取。
en: Parameters for the current run are never replaced automatically mid-run. Legacy saves and the original challenge retain their own rules, and each save continues under its original mode.

zh: 经营规则演习只整理囚犯交接名单，不模拟刷怪、罗盘、契灵与战斗掉落，也不模拟技能历练。名单不提供战力、复活次数、掉落数量或货币收益结论。
en: Management Practice only prepares the Inmate handover list. It does not simulate monster encounters, Compasses, Pactspirits, combat drops, or skill training. The list makes no claims about combat power, revives, drop quantities, or currency returns.

zh: 旧版中的 20 日节奏、事件、刑具奖励、镇压战力、分区和积分均属实验设定。已有旧版存档仍可继续或导入，新局不再提供旧版样本入口，不能据此判断正式经营表现。
en: The 20-day pacing, events, Torture Instrument rewards, suppression power, zones, and scores in legacy versions are experimental settings. Existing legacy saves can still be continued or imported, but new runs no longer offer the legacy sample entry and it must not be used to judge official management performance.

zh: 12 日押运合约 · 原创挑战
独立扩展模式，开局配给 6 或 3 名囚犯与刑具；三个合约按种子公开生成。
en: A standalone expansion mode that begins with 6 or 3 Inmates and Torture Instruments; three contracts are revealed from the seed.
Develop Inmates to Meet Contract Requirements

zh: 合约条件在右侧「本轮经营」查看。持续保留囚犯养成，或按期押运交付。
en: View contract conditions under “Current Run” on the right. Continue developing Inmates or deliver them by escort on schedule.

zh: 轻押运消耗 1 张调度券，整批压力不超过 36；重押运消耗 3 张，压力不超过 72。确认交付后，所选囚犯离开本局。
en: A light escort costs 1 Dispatch Ticket and allows total pressure up to 36; a heavy escort costs 3 and allows pressure up to 72. After delivery is confirmed, the selected Inmates leave the run.

zh: 完成至少两单，包含重囚合约
en: Complete at Least Two Contracts, Including a Heavy-Inmate Contract

zh: 前两次成功交付可整备刑具；每次整备最多刷新一次，消耗 1 券。侦察与押运共用调度券，要为后续合约留券。
en: The first two successful deliveries let you prepare a Torture Instrument. Each preparation allows at most one reroll for 1 ticket. Scouting and escorts share Dispatch Tickets, so save enough for later contracts.

zh: 原创挑战采用固定参数，场面编辑和实验参数校准不可用。积分仅用于比较原创模式表现。
en: The original challenge uses fixed parameters. Scenario editing and experimental calibration are unavailable. Score is only for comparing performance within this original mode.

zh: 撤回上一次实际操作；导入会替换当前本机存档。完整时间轴在游戏左侧查看。
en: Undo the most recent actual action. Importing replaces the current local save. View the complete timeline on the left side of the game.

zh: 在侧栏显示当前可执行选择
en: Show Currently Available Choices in the Sidebar
Cell Doors, Consumes, and Scene Changes

zh: 收起两侧栏，保留中间操作区
en: Collapse Both Sidebars and Keep the Central Action Area

zh: 用于规则练习与场面复核。这里的参数属于本工具的实验配置。
en: For rules practice and scenario review. These parameters are this tool's experimental configuration.

zh: 编辑选中牢房、添加刑具；直接改变本局
en: Edit the selected cell or add Torture Instruments; changes the current run immediately

zh: 调整概率与判定边界，选择新局后应用
en: Adjust probabilities and judgment boundaries; applies after you start a new run

zh: 此操作会直接改变当前练习。先在游戏场面选中牢房，修改后自动保存本机；挑战模式不可编辑。
en: This action changes the current practice run immediately. Select a cell in the game, then make changes; they are saved locally automatically. Challenge mode cannot be edited.

zh: 补齐至臻阶段目标的刑具选择，获得后持续生效。
en: Added Torture Instrument selection for the Ultimate objective; the chosen Instrument remains active.

zh: 补齐绮彩收容后的珍藏选择，多份奖励依次领取。
en: Added Treasure selection after Chromatic containment; multiple rewards are claimed in sequence.

zh: 增加奖励使用记录和效果说明，修正领奖后继续经营的状态。
en: Added reward usage records and effect descriptions, and fixed the state used to continue management after claiming a reward.

zh: 旧存档保留原规则，新建经营局启用本次奖励优化。
en: Legacy saves retain their original rules; newly created management runs use this reward update.

zh: 减少牢房高亮、投影和经营记录的重复计算。
en: Reduced repeated calculations for cell highlights, shadows, and the management log.

zh: 查看菜单、返回起始页或切到后台时暂停场景动画，恢复后继续操作。
en: Scene animations now pause while viewing the menu, returning to the start screen, or leaving the tab, then resume when play continues.

zh: 高分辨率电脑自动控制画面像素量，保持全部牢房和点击区域一致。
en: High-resolution computers now limit rendered pixel count automatically while preserving every cell and its click area.

zh: 补齐旧版浏览器的入口加载与房间列表兼容。
en: Added entry-screen loading and room-list compatibility for older browsers.

zh: 新增象牙、猎物、划痕、鼠巢专项练习与探查操作，显示标记、剩余轮数和目标链接。
en: Added focused practice for Tusk, Prey, Scratch Marks, and Rat Nest, plus the Reveal action, with displays for marks, remaining rounds, and linked targets.

zh: 优化牢房说明与吞噬交互，头狼可选择同阶划痕房，并在鼠标旁确认操作。
en: Improved cell descriptions and Consume interactions. Alpha Wolf can select an equal-tier room with Scratch Marks and confirm the action beside the pointer.

zh: 养成目标改为持续培养更多绮彩，记录收容与珍藏次数，经营结束可查看囚犯交接名单。
en: The development objective now encourages raising more Chromatic Inmates, records containment and Treasure counts, and shows the Inmate handover list when management ends.

zh: 绮彩收容头像新增七彩边框，空位保持灰色，区分已收容与待收容。
en: Chromatic containment portraits now use rainbow borders; empty slots remain gray, clearly separating contained and pending slots.

zh: 简化经营模式入口，只保留经营规则演习和原创挑战；已有旧存档可继续或导入。
en: Simplified the mode selection to Management Practice and the original challenge. Existing legacy saves can still be continued or imported.

zh: 恢复连锁反应与处刑效率，特殊牢房采用醒目徽章，开门后可查看效果并确认或略过，使用后置灰。
en: Restored Chain Reaction and Execution Efficiency. Special cells now use prominent badges; after opening the door, you can review the effect and confirm or skip it, and used effects are grayed out.

zh: 调整左侧目标、刑具与房间效果的排版，避免说明文字重叠。
en: Adjusted the layout of objectives, Torture Instruments, and room effects on the left to prevent explanatory text from overlapping.

zh: 进入游戏先显示二创与作者声明，明确永久免费、请勿付费购买。
en: A derivative-work and author notice now appears before entry, clearly stating that the experience is permanently free and must not be sold.

zh: 加入作者头像、抖音和 B 站主页二维码与链接，便于反馈收费入口。
en: Added the author avatar plus QR codes and links for the Douyin and Bilibili profiles, making paid-access listings easier to report.

zh: 起始页和监狱菜单均可重看声明，关闭后保留存档与当前操作。
en: The notice can be reopened from both the start screen and Prison Menu. Closing it preserves the save and pending action.

zh: 入口加载与浏览器兼容
经营入口先就绪，3D场景在后台加载；场景资源失败仍可使用基础界面。
en: The management interface becomes ready first while the 3D scene loads in the background. The basic interface remains usable if scene assets fail.

zh: 兼容旧浏览器的状态复制与屏幕变化监听，减少首屏按钮失效。
en: Added state-copying and screen-change listeners compatible with older browsers, reducing failures of first-screen buttons.

zh: 增加加载状态、失败提示和重新加载入口，保留已有存档。
en: Added loading status, failure messages, and a reload action while preserving existing saves.

zh: 玩法手册、本局管理、偏好设置和更新日志分别阅读，实验校准移至实验室。
en: The Gameplay Guide, Current Run Management, Preferences, and Changelog now open separately; experimental calibration moved to the Laboratory.

zh: 统一黑石面板、暗红标题、金属边框与浅色文字，加强操作层级。
en: Unified black-stone panels, dark-red headings, metal borders, and light text to strengthen the action hierarchy.

zh: 菜单不再清除待确认选择；修正弹窗内的行动入口，手机短屏可滚动查看。
en: Opening the menu no longer clears a pending confirmation. Action links in dialogs were fixed, and short mobile screens can scroll to all content.

zh: 竖屏显示完整牢笼，横屏填满可用空间；修正 Safari 显示说明，提供主屏幕 App 启动步骤。
en: Portrait orientation now shows the complete prison; landscape fills the available space. Safari guidance was corrected and home-screen app launch steps were added.

zh: 象吃狮、狼；狮吃狼、鼠；狼吃鼠；鼠吃象。
en: Mammoth Consumes Berserk Lion and Alpha Wolf; Berserk Lion Consumes Alpha Wolf and Colossal Rat; Alpha Wolf Consumes Colossal Rat; Colossal Rat Consumes Mammoth.

zh: 象不能吃鼠，双方稀有度仍需相同；升阶与随机变号保持原规则。
en: Mammoth cannot Consume Colossal Rat, and both Inmates must still have the same rarity. Tier gains and random Code changes retain their existing rules.

zh: 辅助建议、处刑效果和续接食物同步更新，旧存档可继续。
en: Assistant advice, execution effects, and follow-up food targets were updated together. Legacy saves remain usable.

zh: 适配手机横屏操作，左右侧栏可完整收起。
en: Added support for landscape mobile controls; both sidebars can now be fully collapsed.

zh: 游戏起始页加入分享图、海报与复制链接。
en: Added a share image, poster, and copy-link action to the game start screen.

zh: 新增全屏入口，左侧经营记录使用单色动物图标。
en: Added a full-screen action; the management log on the left now uses monochrome animal icons.

zh: 原创挑战 · 押运合约
从空监狱开始 · 新手推荐
en: Start with an Empty Prison · Recommended for Beginners

zh: 象牙标记 · 更换囚犯
猎物标记 · 连续升阶
划痕标记 · 头狼吞噬
六名囚犯与钥匙串，开门补给较多。
en: Six Inmates and a Key Ring, with plentiful door-opening supplies.

zh: 三名囚犯与剧痛口枷，控制人数换取升阶。
en: Three Inmates and a Gag of Agony; limit the population in exchange for tier gains.

zh: 三名囚犯、铁盒与鼠头串，等待孵化、寻找同阶配对。
en: Three Inmates, an Iron Box, and a Rat Head Necklace; wait for hatching and seek equal-tier matches.

zh: 原创挑战规则：12 日，三次按种子生成的公开押运合约。前两单成功可整备刑具，每次花1券刷新一次；留券押运。完成至少两单且包含重囚合约才能通过。交付拿走囚犯；侦察和押运共用调度券。
en: Original challenge rules: 12 days and three public escort contracts generated from the seed. The first two successful contracts let you prepare a Torture Instrument; spend 1 ticket to reroll once during each preparation, or save tickets for escorts. To pass, complete at least two contracts including a heavy-inmate contract. Delivered Inmates leave the run; scouting and escorts share Dispatch Tickets.

zh: 相同种子、规则与操作可以重放相同结果。
en: The same seed, rules, and actions reproduce the same results.

zh: 未确认参数保存到存档，修改后开新局应用。
en: Unconfirmed parameters are stored in the save and apply to a new run after changes.

zh: 未确认规则与模拟边界
普通／魔法／稀有／传奇／至臻／绮彩权重
en: Normal / Magic / Rare / Legendary / Ultimate / Chromatic Weights

zh: 巨象／狂狮／头狼／硕鼠权重
en: Mammoth / Berserk Lion / Alpha Wolf / Colossal Rat Weights
Low-Tier Check for the Burning Stake

zh: 被消耗的牢房可重新开启

en: Chromatic Inmates Count Toward Gag Population
Fine Brew Changes Code When Granting a Tier
First and Last Cells Are Adjacent
The parameters above override their corresponding settings.
Save Parameters and Choose a New Run

zh: 战斗、分区和积分为实验设定，未代入真实掉落与价格。
en: Combat, zones, and scores are experimental and do not use official drops or prices.

zh: 下载未保存时，可全选下方内容并保存为 .json 文件。
en: If the download does not save, select all content below and save it as a .json file.

zh: 关键结果自动播报。切换到其他页面时暂停声音。
en: Key outcomes are announced automatically. Sound pauses when you switch to another page.

zh: 确认后，所选囚犯会离开本局。取消选择不消耗调度券。
en: After confirmation, the selected Inmates leave this run. Canceling the selection does not spend a Dispatch Ticket.

zh: 选择目的地，再确认开门。未开牢房的囚犯未知；巡监后进入本日经营。
en: Choose a destination, then confirm that you want to open the door. Inmates in unopened cells are unknown; the current management day begins after the patrol.

zh: 巨象吃狂狮、头狼；狂狮吃头狼、硕鼠；头狼吃硕鼠；硕鼠吃巨象。巨象不能吃硕鼠。双方需同稀有度；鼠头串额外允许同阶硕鼠互吃。
en: Mammoth Consumes Berserk Lion and Alpha Wolf; Berserk Lion Consumes Alpha Wolf and Colossal Rat; Alpha Wolf Consumes Colossal Rat; Colossal Rat Consumes Mammoth. Mammoth cannot Consume Colossal Rat. Both must have the same rarity; a Rat Head Necklace also allows equal-tier Colossal Rats to Consume one another.

zh: 普通 → 魔法 → 稀有 → 传奇 → 至臻 → 绮彩。吞噬基础升一阶，并随机调整代号；刑具可能额外升阶。达到绮彩后离开牢房，进入右侧单独收容，可培养多名。
en: Normal → Magic → Rare → Legendary → Ultimate → Chromatic. A Consume grants 1 base Rarity Tier and randomly changes the Code; Torture Instruments may grant additional tiers. At Chromatic, an Inmate leaves its cell for separate containment on the right. Multiple Inmates can be developed.

zh: 换会重新随机代号与稀有度，可能降阶。结束推进至下一日；事件与奖励需要先处理。
en: Replace rerolls both Code and rarity and may lower the tier. End advances to the next day; events and rewards must be resolved first.

zh: 合约条件可在右侧展开查看。交付后囚犯离开本轮；前两单成功可整备刑具，每次刷新消耗1券、最多一次。
en: Expand contract conditions on the right. Delivered Inmates leave the run. The first two successful contracts allow Torture Instrument preparation; each preparation permits at most one reroll for 1 ticket.

zh: 当前模拟：吞噬不额外耗日，每日可换一次；次数、概率及部分刑具边界仍待正式规则校准。打开菜单可查看玩法手册。
en: Current simulation: Consumes cost no additional days, and one Replace is allowed per day. Counts, probabilities, and some Torture Instrument edge cases still await calibration against the official rules. Open the menu to view the Gameplay Guide.

zh: 刷宝游戏工具箱 · 分享
把塔罗斯监狱分享给朋友
快人一步熟悉玩法，搬砖猛猛起飞。下载分享图或二维码海报，邀请朋友一起试试。
en: Learn the mechanics early and get a head start on farming. Download a share image or QR-code poster and invite friends to try it.

zh: 参考公开展示与测试资料进行个人二创，玩家自制、非官方。模拟中的节奏、难度与收益不代表正式游戏；游戏名称、官方玩法及相关素材的权利归原权利人。
en: This personal, fan-made derivative work references publicly shown and test materials and is unofficial. Its pacing, difficulty, and rewards do not represent the released game. Rights to the game name, official mechanics, and related assets belong to their respective owners.

zh: 塔罗斯监狱横向分享图：永久免费，请勿付费；附作者抖音、B站与官网二维码
en: Tartarus Prison landscape share image: always free—do not pay. Includes QR codes for the creator's Douyin, Bilibili, and official website.

zh: 图片暂时无法加载，你仍可复制官网链接。
en: The image cannot be loaded right now. You can still copy the website link.

zh: 扫码打开 刷宝游戏工具箱 官网
en: Scan to Open the Loot-Farming Game Toolbox Website

zh: 官网链接，可选中手动复制
en: Website link; select it to copy manually
